definitions.explanation: Strong, visible happiness — typically used to describe someone's reaction to good news or a welcome surprise. The {大|おお} prefix intensifies {喜|よろこ}び.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大喜|おおよろこ}びだった。
examples.english: He was overjoyed by the present.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大喜|おおよろこ}び⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The whole family was overjoyed at the news of his passing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧くる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦しっぽ→しっぽ：09089_shippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}って→振る：01983_furu⟧{大喜|おおよろこ}び⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the owner comes home, the dog wags its tail in delight.

notes:
{大|おお} (big) + ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧ (joy). Used both as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb ({大喜|おおよろこ}び⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大喜|おおよろこ}び⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be overjoyed
- {大喜|おおよろこ}びで: with great delight (adverbial)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大喜|おおよろこ}び: overjoyed at ～

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧: joy — neutral; lower intensity
- ⟦{歓喜|かんき}→歓喜：13172_kanki⟧: rapture; great joy — more formal/literary; sometimes used for collective joy (e.g., a stadium of fans)
- ⟦{狂喜|きょうき}→狂喜：06435_kyouki⟧: wild/frantic joy — even stronger, sometimes with a connotation of being beside oneself
